The research programme focuses on the development of nonlinear Data-Driven Predictive Control methodologies for dynamical systems subject to stochastic uncertainty. The activities will investigate the design of explainable control algorithms capable of exploiting information from data to describe and predict the behavior of nonlinear dynamical systems. Particular attention will be devoted to uncertainty characterization and management, the interpretability of control laws, and the analysis of closed-loop stability, robustness, and performance guarantees.
